description: Find public Hyatus stays when choosing a location, dates, guest capacity or amenities. Each call searches the supplied filters; use nextOffset with the same filters for another page. Results include public slugs and links, not a reservation or availability guarantee.

filters.description: Structured stay preferences. Explicit fields override interpreted ones; prompt amenities are combined with explicit amenities. For refine, omitted fields keep current filters, empty strings clear fields, and [] clears amenities. Clear both dates together.

adults.description: Adult count as a whole-number string from '1' to '100'; combined with children for required guest capacity.

amenities.description: Required public amenity labels, such as 'WiFi' or 'Gym'. Use [] to clear; duplicates are removed.

items.description: Public amenity label from a listing or catalog result.

bathrooms.description: Minimum bathroom count, allowing half bathrooms, such as '1.5' or '2+'. Omit or clear for no preference.

bedrooms.description: Minimum bedrooms, such as '2' or '2+'. 'Studio' or '0' selects zero bedrooms. Omit or use an empty string for no preference.

beds.description: Minimum whole-number bed count, such as '2' or '2+'. Omit or clear for no preference.

checkIn.description: Local arrival date in YYYY-MM-DD format, with no time or UTC conversion. Supply checkOut too.

checkOut.description: Local departure date in YYYY-MM-DD format, after checkIn and at most 366 nights later. Checkout day is not an occupied night. Supply checkIn too.

children.description: Child count as a whole-number string from '0' to '100'; combined with adults for required guest capacity.

city.description: City name from the public catalog, such as 'New Haven'. Omit or clear for all cities.

destination.description: Free-text destination or listing search, matched against public catalog text.

discountCode.description: Preferred-rate code supplied by the guest. Pricing trims and uppercases it, then checks eligibility; search only retains it as context.

guests.description: Minimum guest capacity as a whole-number string from '1' to '100'; a whole number is also accepted. A positive adults + children total takes precedence.

infants.description: Infant count as a whole-number string from '0' to '100'. Retained as search context; infants do not increase the guest-capacity filter.

propertyType.description: Property type: Apartment, Home, Studio or Cabin. Matching ignores case and surrounding spaces; empty or unrecognized values remove this filter.

searchToken.description: Opaque public search token returned by a previous search, for retaining its semantic matches. Never supply an authentication or guest-access token.

sort.description: Result order: recommended, relevance, bedrooms, guests, city, price or newest. Unknown values use recommended order; availability ranking takes precedence.

stayLength.description: Stay length in nights as a whole-number string from '1' to '366'. Retained as stay context; explicit checkIn/checkOut determine the priced dates.

unitType.description: Unit type: Apartment or House. Matching ignores case and surrounding spaces; empty or unrecognized values remove this filter.

limit.description: Page size. Public discovery tools return 12 homes per page (or fewer on the last page).

offset.description: Zero-based result offset in multiples of 12. Use the returned nextOffset with the same filters for the next page; out-of-range pages clamp to the last page.

name: search_hyatus_stays
title: Find furnished stays
